_comment: Lab 09 Exercise 2. HIGH findings reviewed and ACCEPTED by a person, each with a reason and a compensating control. Read by scripts/utilities/usms-iam-audit.sh. An entry without both is ignored. Remove an entry the day its reason stops being true.

accepted.finding: service principal ec2.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
accepted.reason: EC2 does not send aws:SourceArn/aws:SourceAccount when it assumes an instance-profile role, so a confused-deputy condition on this trust would deny every instance (the role would stop working). It cannot be fixed with a condition.
accepted.compensating_control: Who can hand this role to an instance is controlled instead: USMSDeployBase explicitly DENIES iam:PassRole to ec2.amazonaws.com; credentials are only reachable through the instance metadata service, which is meant to require IMDSv2 tokens with hop limit 1 (Step 11 - not enforceable on Floci 1.7.0, enforced on real AWS).

accepted.finding: service principal ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
accepted.reason: This is an AWS service-linked role (path /aws-service-role/): AWS owns and manages its trust policy and it cannot be edited by the account. It was created by Lab 06's register-scalable-target.
accepted.compensating_control: Only the Application Auto Scaling service itself can assume a service-linked role, and its permissions are an AWS-managed policy scoped to ECS scaling; deleting the scalable target (lab-06-cleanup.sh) is what removes it.
